active_mainline: Strictly 1D normal layer-LJ in continuous physical time t, with full nonlinear mechanics, exact transport, explicitly labeled statistical-mechanical limits, and correlation-derived axial statistical-cell scales
scope_freeze: Remain strictly in one-dimensional normal tension until P(lambda,t) is physically identified and validated. 2D/3D display geometry is allowed for tensile-test visualization, but 2D/3D mechanics, multiaxial criteria, specimen hazard integration, and 3D mini-mesh probability coupling are deferred.
state: P(lambda,t) has exact transport and physical equilibrium constraints. Probability aggregation distinguishes complete identical dependence, partial dependence, and true independence. The exact variance-equivalent statistical length belongs to the true stationary correlation sequence; deterministic finite snapshots use a separately labeled first-positive-lobe estimator because the all-lag sample-mean-centered plug-in sum has an exact zero-sum artifact.

prepared_scaffolds.fem1d_status: Prepared but deliberately uncoupled from the active P(lambda,t) theory. It is a reversible continuum reference/interface, not a fatigue model.
prepared_scaffolds.fem1d_integrated_app_behavior: The desktop app validates tensile-test inputs, computes A=width*thickness, runs the C solver, reloads CSV results, and exposes time-step plus 2D/3D stress/strain display controls in one window. It does not contain P(lambda,t), fatigue damage, or crack probability.
prepared_scaffolds.visualization_rule: 2D/3D display geometry may be extruded from the 1D bar, but every displayed cross-section inherits only the axial scalar stress/strain from the underlying 1D element. No shear, von-Mises, transverse constitutive law, or multiaxial failure model is active.

current_result: For true stationary 1D correlations, Var(mean_M)=sigma_lambda^2*tau_M/M exactly and M_eff=M/tau_M, ell_stat_2=a0*tau_M. For one deterministic sample-mean-centered snapshot the all-lag weighted covariance sum is exactly zero, so a first-positive-lobe estimator is used instead. In the dynamically matched M=31,63,127,255 sweep, M_eff_hat_plus is approximately 2.929, 2.986, 3.029, 3.054, while ell_stat_2_hat_plus/a0 is approximately 10.584, 21.101, 41.934, 83.489. Thus the tested chain retains system-scale coherent dependence and does not yet provide a converged local material correlation length. Complete identity remains distinct from partial dependence, and event independence still requires joint factorization.
next_target: Stay in 1D. Determine whether the observed system-scale coherence is caused by the present boundary/loading protocol or persists in a physically appropriate 1D ensemble. Continue identifying P(lambda,t), and later derive an event/first-passage clustering length separately from the second-moment statistical length. Do not assign a fixed local mini-cell or identify A0 with a statistical independence area without an independent physical derivation. The integrated FEM application remains an uncoupled tensile-only scaffold until those probability-theory steps are resolved.
